extracted.strategy: Invests at least 80% of assets in AAA-rated CLOs (directly and via the PGIM AAA CLO ETF) while adding a duration overlay using longer-duration fixed-income instruments and derivatives to target a weighted average portfolio duration close to the broad U.S. bond market.
extracted.notes: Fund is newly offered (no historical turnover). Net expense ratio of 0.19% reflects a permanent management fee waiver equal to unitary fees earned by PGIM Investments on the underlying PGIM AAA CLO ETF sleeve, eliminating double-layering; gross is 0.37% including 0.18% acquired fund fees. Duration overlay targets ~5.76-year duration (broad U.S. bond market as of April 2026) on top of sub-1-year floating-rate CLO exposure — an unusual hybrid structure. Up to 20% may be in A-/AA-rated CLOs.
